Space Waves is a fast-paced, side-scrolling arcade skill game released in April 2024 by do.games, heavily inspired by the wave mode mechanics of Geometry Dash. 
Core Gameplay & Controls
Objective: Guide an automatic-moving arrow safely through narrow, neon-lit space tunnels without crashing into walls, spinning cogs, or spike clusters. 
Space Waves
 +2
Controls: One-button/key control where holding down the left mouse button, spacebar, or up arrow makes the arrow fly diagonally upward, and releasing makes it drop diagonally downward. 
Levels & Difficulty: Features 33 levels in standard web versions and 80+ handcrafted levels on mobile apps, color-coded and rated by difficulty from easy green faces to extreme red demon levels. 
Space Waves
 +2
Game Modes
Classic Mode: Stage-based progression through distinct worlds and layouts.
Endless Mode: Survival-focused continuous scaling speed and high score tracking.
Race Mode: Compete against AI-controlled opponents across over 19 separate racing levels.
Practice Mode: Allows players to place checkpoints or respawn near crash points to master difficult patterns.
